Container.Name: tg2nzb
Container.Overview:
Telegram channel to SABnzbd bridge. Listens to configured Telegram channels via a Telethon userbot, downloads posted .nzb attachments and uploads them to SABnzbd (mode=addfile) with category, priority and an optional password parsed from the caption. Sends Pushover notifications.
IMPORTANT: First start needs the Telegram login. Start the container, then in the Unraid terminal run: docker attach tg2nzb -- enter phone number and code, detach with Ctrl+P then Ctrl+Q (Ctrl+C stops the container). The session is stored in /data and reused afterwards.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Holds config.yaml. ENV variables below override values in that file.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Telegram session, SQLite dedup database, heartbeat. Do NOT delete the session file.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL
Config.Description: SABnzbd base URL as reachable from this container (incl. url_base if set).

Config.Name: SABnzbd NZB/API Key
Config.Description: NZB key from SABnzbd Config → General is enough. The full API key additionally enables the category check at startup.

Config.Name: SABnzbd Category
Config.Description: SABnzbd category (must exist in SAB). Destination folder and unpack come from it. Empty = SAB default. Per-channel categories only via config.yaml (channel_categories).

Config.Name: SABnzbd Priority
Config.Description: -100 = category default, -2 paused, -1 low, 0 normal, 1 high, 2 force

Config.Name: SABnzbd Post-Processing
Config.Description: -1 = category default (recommended, set unpack in the SAB category), 0 none, 1 +repair, 2 +repair/unpack, 3 +repair/unpack/delete

Config.Name: Include Keywords
Config.Description: Optional, comma-separated. Only NZBs whose filename or caption contains one of these words (whole word, case-insensitive) are queued.

Config.Name: Exclude Keywords
Config.Description: Optional, comma-separated. NZBs whose filename or caption contains one of these words are skipped.

Config.Name: Backfill Limit
Config.Description: On start, scan the last N messages per channel. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Backfill Max Age (hours)
Config.Description: Only posts younger than N hours in the backfill. 0 = no limit. Empty = config.yaml.
